notes.title: The Warhorn - Devlog #7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/2031683d2eec5accb7c9eb7b03feb3e248275f7f.png[/img]
Dear adventurers!
We are pleased to announce that with every update, released in regular timelines, we are
adding new mechanics and features to the experimental version of The Warhorn, that is
running on Unreal Engine 5. In the last few updates there have been multiple features added
to The Warhorn. Remember that this is just the beginning, as our roadmap contains many more changes that you will see in the nearest future. As in the last update we have added the mechanic of first mini game – Capture The Flag - we will organize several events that will be using it, testing also other network features, strictly connected with multiplayer mechanisms.

[h2]How we stopped worrying and learned to love the sticks[/h2]
In Unreal Engine 5 player gear progression will have more layers than in UE4 (default
version) Warhorn - as you can see, in one of the first updates we have introduced tier 0 or
so-called ‘caveman gear’.

Stone & stick tools are easy to make, cheap and don’t break too easily, but damage-wise
they will be the worst choice of weapons in the game. As a result, every tool after this first
step will be much sturdier. After crafting your first set of tools you should look for some
metals. And speaking of metals...


[h2]The Copper Age[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/aedb3b0f42627a2ed123876b03c42922171f26ab.png[/img]
Copper tools and weapons will be the foundation of early game gathering and combat. Also,
you will not be forced to settle down before crafting your first set of tools.

No, you wouldn't be able to smelt every ore in the game without settling down, but there will
be no need to sacrifice too much if you want to explore and find your perfect spot. You will be
able to craft copper tools, go to a good place to build a base and start gathering resources.

[h2]Introducing…pig[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/0847e41e467fc7ac35edce6a9590bce8981edb57.png[/img]
In the last published roadmap we have promised that deer will be the first introduced animal,
but due to the need of redesigning some aspects of The Warhorn’s hunting mechanics and
ranged combat we finally decided that you will see pigs at a much earlier stage.

As you remember, in UE4 pigs were one of basic huntable animals and this will not change
in the new version of the game, but hunting will be much easier and more immersive. Yeah,
this chonker will be easy to catch but getting better animal based materials will require a
more serious hunting..


[h2]Early map expansion and building mechanics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/b29a55cd1bd030216f23d87df3e5e210a780936f.png[/img]
In the default version of The Warhorn you will soon see large chunks added to the map at
the north-west and south-east. We are preparing building spaces and realizing the first
phase of expansion of the green biome. Before implementation of the next biome we want to
polish, expand and refine the main highland area. Previous map from UE4 version had one,
most important problem - it was big enough, but a large part of features was stretched
around various corners and hard to reach.

In the experimental (UE5) version, the map will be open for exploration like in default
Warhorn (UE4) but in new version we have a new philosophy - ‘quality over quantity’. There
will be no filler plains, never-ending roads or other features typical for too large open worlds.


[h2]Social Media growth and diversification[/h2]
We are also happy to announce that our community is constantly growing – our social
medias are now more active, so if you want to see new materials created actually in The
Warhorn, so as be up to date with news (not only about updates, but also events, sales and
giveways), there are more ways to achieve it. As The Warhorn had it official channels on
Facebook, Twitter and Instagram, we have started adding regular videos on our Tiktok and
created our official subreddit. You can also join our Discord, where you can ask our dev team
directly about in-game features. All social medias channels are being fulfilled with materials
and discussions about the game – check and join r/TheWarhornGame

notes.title: The Warhorn - Devlog #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/fa37e49795f75e1156d44728eae32b018f536ff8.png[/img]
[h3]Multiplayer and stability in experimental version[/h3]
After the stress test from 5 November and another round of internal network tests we
needed to fix some stuff and now we have good resultats-basic foundations of UE5 multiplayer are working as intended. No desync problems, random lags or weird crashes.

Also we have potentially fixed some niche problems with some hardware and software
configurations so UE5 will be more stable than UE4.

[h3]Return of the Bag
[/h3]
In the UE5 version the inventory system is partially rewritten from a technical standpoint and
we are getting much better results. Overall, the inventory system will run smoothly and be
slightly less janky.

New standard for the largest stack will be 120 units in one inventory slot and the smallest
one will be possibly somewhere around 15-30. Tools and weapons will not be stackable but
overall they will last longer than in the UE4 version so going to dunegons with more than 3
swords will be a thing of the past.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/4b0da3516074a48f473ac192cb3145771a7de2ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cold iron shall be the master of you all.. [/h3]

In UE5 we are overhauling the entire crafting system so magic can appear later in
development. The Warhorn needed some changes to stay fresh and some old systems were
requiring extra attention.

Firstly, early in the UE5 lifecycle we will introduce cooper and stone as resources for crafting
tools. This step was hotly debated inside our team but after one month of analysis we
decided that iron will no longer be the first and only tier of tools. Yeah, this means that you
will get iron tools slightly later.

But don’t worry, this change does not mean that you will dig copper with tools made of mud
and later dig iron with something that breaks if your character sneezes in the wrong
direction. Tools in future updates will be more durable and resource gathering will be more
satisfying.

[h3]On Early Access[/h3]
As you understand The Warhorn is still in early access and we're working on future updates.
Experimental version usually gets updated more than two times in a week and with every
week we are moving forward with production of graphic assets, code and animations.

Updates of UE5 version are small and numerous so we are not writing path notes for every
bug or code fix. It would mean that you would get community post every 2-4 days or even
every day.

Unreal Engine 4 version was getting larger updates to the main branch and smaller updates
to the developer branch, it’s normal thing in game development. Visible updates were often
sum of smaller ones-we are not informing about the gap between x.x.47 and x.x.49 because
you are only interested in changes between x.1.x and x.2.x.

Overall change to update frequency doesn't mean that we ,,do less stuff”. We only
decreased amount of patch notes that we are publishing on steam. This will soon change, 
and we will start sharing regular patch notes from the experimental version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/48e74700bbf02c2370f98790d5ef69a0262d4e44.png[/img]

[h3]Message from Krawiec (Game designer)[/h3]

Hi, today I want to touch on one specific topic-difference between planned content from
devlogs and things that I currently have on the drawing board or project documentation.

Firstly, on devlogs we are often informing the community about incoming work-in-progress
features. If you see a model, animation or element of terrain this often means that we are
working on it. If something is on concept art-we are planning to soon start work on it or we
are currently working on this asset.

Second category is stuff from internal project documentation (such as GDD) or designer’s
drawing board. Currently in my spare time I'm working on game design and mechanics of
undead biome, polearms, two handed weapons and capybara mount.
This doesn't mean that we can or should talk about or promise those features. Yes, we can
do that and actions like this could increase the amount of copies sold but really…it would
end someday and unethical business practices often lead to downfall.

If you need technical support or have any questions about Warhorn’s development you can
always ask on our discord server. https://discord.gg/SbsRXMM

notes.title: The Warhorn - experimental version is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/15c28bec663c869be5cbaf53b9f29809963d7776.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/660920/view/3405311447044190135
After many weeks of work, unhealthy amounts of energy drinks and serious exposure to UE5
we can now announce the Experimental Version of UE5 update.

Experimental Version will be stripped from most of Warhorn’s game mechanics-everything is
work in progress and we are working on the re-implantation of core mechanics but the first
alpha test will be focused on network code and graphic optimization.

[h2]New engine, new challenges[/h2]
Games in early access can be janky, poorly optimized or even not work at all. Well, even
some AAA games can crash at specific conditions…so we decided that giving a possibility to
test graphical settings and other aspects of experimental build to players would be a good
idea.

Yes, you don’t need to wait for the full beta release to check if the UE5 version will work on
your PC!

[h2]Multiplayer not from day one..but before day one[/h2]
Experimental version even without a large chunk will have a multiplayer gamemode. In
future all quests, locations and other adventures will be avabile in fully supported
multiplayer-coop and PVP.

Network code will receive further improvments, so in the UE5 version you will be able to just
call your squad, open a can of soda and have a good Friday evening with The Warhorn.

[h2]Network test[/h2]
With the release of the Experimental version we will start a new event-open multiplayer test
for everyone interested in supporting Warhorn’s development. We need your help to optimize
network code and provide lag-free experience in future updates.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]1.Will the new UE5 version replace the current Warhorn?[/b]
No, Experimental UE5 version will be a beta branch and updating to UE5 will require
manually changing to the beta branch via steam.

In the future after the release of the UE5 upgrade Unreal Engine 4 version (current one) of
the Warhorn will be available as a beta branch. We are not taking a game that you bought
from you and if you will prefer an old Warhorn-you will be able to return to the old version.

[b]2.Who can participate in an open multiplayer test?[/b]
Open multiplayer test….well, everyone with a legally purchased copy of Warhorn and
working internet connection. We don’t require a ,,tester” rank in our discord server for this
test.

[b]3.When UE5 will receive full implenentation of gameplay mechanics?[/b]
Experimental version should be considered a benchmark for the UE5 version and game
mechanics are currently revised, reimagined, fixed or reworked. Most basic (such as
inventory) ones will return soon.

The Warhorn in UE4 version had a problem with source code that had some elements
backing to first builds from…2018. Yes, some scripts were 4 years old and others…were
somewhat creepy.

Example-UE4 version has a strange script that reduces damage in PvP, nobody knows when
it was written and where it comes from and how it works. Another one is a short code without
connection to other parts of the game and The Warhorn brutally crashes without it..

As you understand, we really need to revisit some elements of the Warhorn source code and
remove weird (or possibly extraterrestrial in origin…) scripts. It will be much shorter than
starting from scrap but we need some time.

[b]4.Upgrade to UE5 will be a paid DLC?[/b]
No, you paid for The Warhorn once and supported us with your wallet. We are not planning
to charge you for an update.

Also to get access to the experimental branch you will need to manually change to beta
version via steam-UE5 version will not appear as dlc.

[b]5.Wait….UE5 version has a new map?[/b]
Yes, with the UE5 upgrade we are implementing a new map with new content. Most of the
game mechanics will also be revamped.

Old map was big but…had a lot of problems with implantation and optimization. Map from
the experimental build is planned as a small part of a much larger world that will run
smoother and will be larger than the old map.



If you want to help us develop the game or have other questions regarding The Warhorn, 
join our Discord! https://discord.gg/SbsRXMM

notes.title: The Warhorn - Devlog #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/b3ce7244ef0bab7b8909f5b9e9d148cccefc247c.png[/img]
Hello everyone to our 4th devlog! We are very excited to share more development information with you!

[h3]New Team Members[/h3]
We start this devlog with a great news, two more people have joined our team. A short message from our new 3D artist Aitrik and 3D animator AgeTheGee below.

[i]Hi! I'm Albert (Aitrik). Currently, I'm responsible for creating new assets, creatures and redesigning old ones (anything that includes 3D modeling).[/i]

[i]Hi There Everyone!😄 I'm Agata (AgeTheGeek) and I'm a 3D animator for softwares like Blender & Maya. I'll be working on animations for creatures and characters that you can meet within the game. I'll do my best to make Warhorn's animation section look great! If you have any questions, feel free to text me on Discord [/i]

[h3]Experimental Version[/h3]
The new version of The Warhorn game on which we have focused all our efforts, is only available for developers. We called it the experimental version, it is built on the new Unreal Engine 5.

In this version, part of the game is completely created from scratch, we rewrite old mechanics, which are improved and optimized so that players get a much better feeling from the game than before. As a result, we have the opportunity to test the game at an early stage and get rid of bugs that caused bothersome network lags. 

The version is still in a stripped down form, but we consider releasing this version to the public Steam branch. And therefore each of you could play and see how the new version of The Warhorn is created and how it changes, where all the community ideas and opinions would be appreciated. Let us know in the comments if you want to play the experimental version now or if you'd rather wait for the game to be released on the official Steam version. /Lubasz

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/8b3c176840e11c8f4368548f2827270f98cb88f0.png[/img]


[h3]Game World[/h3]
We would like to give you a glimpse of what is currently going around map and level design in The Warhorn. 
 
We are currently working on completely new map which is divided into several distinct and unique sections. Each region will contain new activities, different type of biomes, structures to explore and new enemies to face. Every bigger update will add new region to the map, as well as part of main plot connected with it.
 
First one will include mainly default green biome with some mountain area. Regions are packed with content and interesting places to explore, but we are aware of realism and sense of scale in the game. We don’t want to throw you into a map, where action is constantly happening or there is nothing to do – we would like to keep it balanced and pleasing to play as much as possible. Here are some screenshots from current WIP locations. Can’t wait to share the whole region with you! /Pavvlito

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/dc4acaf38639893835b2a1aa321a3f4300daf948.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/c0f5a5c5367f1fdb8588e23bc251e70cf22ebfda.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/4eafc6f415f74bb511acdcc478add7b110a1185b.png[/img]


[h3]Lore[/h3]
Crows
„Beware of them” the Old man said, his eyes turned into two men who guard the village.
Their equipment was well-made, far beyond reach of the typical watchman.

„If they relate you to other races or magic, they will break you. You will confess to
everything. Even to things you could not do, and then they will hang you.” He finished with
small on his face.

„Why they do that!?” The boy was upset and frightened.

„Did you saw a fish washed ashore?”

„Yes, I did bu…” Old man interrupt him.

„They are like that fish. Their death is coming, the more they struggle, the less oxygen is left.”

Most loyal servants of the von Tiers family and The Crown. The impact of cataclysm was
biggest for nobility, and it was not in they favor. They have to act quickly to maintain they
power. To do so, head of the von Tiers family, gather troops and moved into Tyros, the place
where the anomaly began. They want to achieve two things there. One is secure extraction of
the magic crystal, which may be crucial for the State. The second thing is to understand what
happened and how to reverse the anomaly. The leader of the group is called Baron and his
most trusted man is called Lieutenant. They are proud, loyal and fearless warriors, and they
live by the chivalric code. By the other hand, they feel only contempt to other races and hate
everything which is linked with magic. This attitude is especially seen in Baron behaviors.
The group name emerged from von Tiers crest /Caim

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/60acf3abee4f851d847866daeb72a483a5e608f2.png[/img]

[h3]Damage Changes[/h3]
In the UE5 version there will be only three main damage types - ranged, melee and magic.
Each damage type will be boosted by different bonuses from perk tree and will have
seperated upgrades for damage and critical damage.

Yes, magic will be a valid option for damage-focused and support characters. Sadly, magical
part of perk tree will not be include in first build of UE5 version due to need for fast release of
stable version and fact that magic is available after early game.

Also, in UE5 you will see a new damage type called ,,armor-piercing damage” that as you
can imagine…ignores armor. Starting random fights even with weaker players can end with
taking some damage and brute forcing damage through monster resistances will be more
forgiving but not optimal.

[b]Speaking of monster resistances..[/b]
Players will only have damage resistances from armor but in the cases of many creatures
that inhabit world of Warhorn resistances will be split into three categories-melee, magic and
ranged. There will be no arrow-proof or sword-proof creatures but having a party with mixed
playstyles can help in some situations.

[b]New perk tree[/b]
The UE5 version will bring new perk tree and big changes to leveling systems-player
characters will level up more often but each level will give less power than in previous power
so we will be able to give you a much longer perk tree with less powercreep.

[i]Survival[/i] skills will be contained in two different branches-gatherer and survivor. Each
branch will contains different sub-branches like survivor's ,,athlete line” that gives extra
movement speed and deerslaying ,,forester”.

[i]Combat[/i] is damage focused and contains branches with bonuses for melee and ranged
combat. In the future we will add a magic branch but further re-implementation of magic
system will require some time.

[i]Rogue[/i] is also known as ,,lol, i didn’t expected that” branch. Here you can decrease fall
damage, improve stealth and bring to PvP battlefield deception-based (or overall based
tactics..) to bamboozle other players.

[i]Defense[/i] branch will improve your survivability in combat and in future updates will counter
some nasty abilities of some monsters.

[i]Building[/i] is all about improving structures and making better defenses. Defense specialist
will be able to create insanely improved fortifications and fix breaches with only basic
resources. /Krawiec

notes.title: The Warhorn - Devlog #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/de14ff62910c5f7c1404ff5fa9877be178bb8eea.png[/img]

Hi Everyone and welcome to our third devlog! Today we have a few topics to discuss.
But before we start, there’s someone who wants to tell you something:


„Imagine a world. Place which belong to the people. This piece of land was granted to them by the gods, so they could work hard and earn their place in the afterlife. Think about the desert, traveled by nomad clans. Picture the highest mountains, which could almost touch the sky. Fields so lush that they looked like rough seas. May the picture of children, women and man, working together, performing their duties by the divinity's will and with methods, shared from father to son, burn into your mind. It all perished. Monsters flooded our world. Beasts hide somewhere in our woods, and forgotten by the deities races, live in our villages. In one night, our past, present, and future ceased to exist. We angered our gods, and they, in return, began the End of Times!” — Aban, traveler and cartographer


[h3]Lore[/h3]
Alright, last week we have been working really hard to create the whole world and main plot. Most important event was some kind of anomaly which changed everything. Only few people know what exactly happened. By progressing the main quests, you will learn more about that event. What’s essential, when that anomaly happened, magic found a way to this world. Plants and animals are not the same they used to be. Next was nasty beasts and monsters who came after magic, they brought chaos and anarchy with them. All states try to survive in this grim time and new races try to find their home in our globe. Planet has changed. You will wake up on an island after a shipwreck. There are three main groups with different purposes and goals. To save the world, they have to start to work together. Monster and beasts, they are just a part of something older and more evil. This world needs heroes like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/8d3e94fd17cd89e2456719e4020ad1bede44526b.png[/img]

[h3]Unreal Engine 5[/h3]
Migration stage continued… Moving the game to the new Unreal Engine 5 is our priority, and we focus all developer resources on it. Many features have been changed in the new engine that require a long analysis and looking for the problems in the existing code. The game is very complex and has many mechanics, so the entire migration process may take a little longer. Most of the game features work properly, and the game is playable on the new engine, but we still require more time. Despite everything, we hope that we will release the new update soon, which will be on the new version of the Unreal Engine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/96ac47dfaf723d72ae67035c9b98290e45361eeb.jpg[/img]

[h3]New World[/h3]
We are currently working on a new map that will introduce the player to the wonderful world of the game, show the first mechanics and take him to a world full of adventures and dangerous creatures. Although The Warhorn is a survival builder game, we want the world to harmonize with the story and provide the players with even more adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/00530d5fb16f673de7e29379df2fe42f711416a5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Redesign UI[/h3]
There will also be changes to the player's interface (UI/HUD). We want the game to feel even better so that the player quickly understands how to use it after entering the game. We received plenty of messages where players had trouble reading or understanding the UI correctly. Not only will we create the interface larger, make it more readable but also, add more interactive elements that will make the interface intuitive.

[h3]Perk tree and damage balance[/h3]
We want to further refine the balance of the game, so the perk tree will be modified and divided into sections that will focus even more on combat, survival, and building. More and different bonuses will be added that will diversify the gameplay and reward the player. In addition, new types of damage will be created, depending on the type of weapon and attack.

 	We want to share more about each story fraction. That’s why we are going to publish a devlog specific for each of them. When? Stay tuned and join our discord server https://discord.gg/SbsRXMM. Please share with us your opinion about the story and changes! We cannot wait to hear from you!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/6f2c1f4787c3d9562fde6502556e80fa91ebdd90.png[/img]

Welcome everyone to our second Devlog on The Warhorn development. ːTheWarhornLogoː

[h3]The Warhorn Team[/h3]
Over the past four weeks, a new development team has been trained and prepared to work on The Warhorn game and as a result, we managed to release a new update last week.
It was a busy time, but it was spent in a wonderful atmosphere. It was a great decision to enlarge the team because the work on the game is gaining momentum.

We are glad to say that another person joined The Warhorn Team this week. Please welcome Caim who is a writer, he will help us improve our lore and will definitely bring a brilliant vibe to the game.

A short message from Caim below.
Hi everyone! My name is Kuba (Caim), my job is to deliver you memorable, interesting characters and enjoyable stories. We’re doing what we can to make The Warhorn a great game. Stay tuned and if you have any questions, you can find me on the discord server.


[h3]Next Update[/h3]
All the time we work on early game balance such as arranging the old town to make it easier for new players. We adjust the treasure chests items to make the game fairer and not totally random as The Warhorn's balance is not good and players can run around with heavy metal armor after a few minutes of play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/15172660188fd55169fed4c7e97b62438d38c466.jpg[/img]

We will also reduce death losses, in the current version of the game it's a lot bugs where players can die through no fault of theirs, we don't want it to discourage people from playing.

Additionally, we are constantly focusing on bug fixing that hinder the gameplay.


[h3]Unreal Engine 5[/h3]
The first step in migration is done, we finally successfully opened a project in Unreal Engine 5. There are still a lot of errors in the project but this is the first huge step for the game, next stage is to fix fatal errors, migrate plugins and finally compile the game.

There are still many challenges ahead of us but we are really determined to fully migrate the game because we see the potential of the version of the engine and work in the new engine is well optimized. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/28b3223237ca8a59b2e5301f3fe618b936836aee.png[/img]


[h3]Creatures[/h3]
The behavior of creatures is very problematic, they are stiff, unnatural, sometimes freezing and not fighting well, they cause many problems that affect performance. We analyze the animal code and with each update we improve them to finally create a good enemies to fight in the world of The Warhorn.

Hello everyone!
It's nice to announce that we're kicking off our first developer blog! 

[h3]NEW TEAM[/h3]
The last year The Warhorn wasn't going well, but its time to change!
We have taken some big steps to help The Warhorn raise from its knees. One of them was enlarge the team, because we are aware that two people can't handle with such a big game. We've spent the last weeks looking for awesome people, so please welcome our new team members!

@Martat - UE4 Programmer

@Szkuti - AI Programmer
@Pavvlito - Level Designer & 2D Artist
@Abbinco - Concept Artist

We want to improve building, combat and exploration because we know that is the core of the game. Furthermore we will optimize the multiplayer to give you the opportunity to enjoy the game with your friends.

We are aware that the early game is lame, so in the next update we will focus on item balance and we are going to add tier 0 equipement for new players. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/4573fe523c210a1bcf27fce07ff2b4815f1c6ad2.png[/img]
Big Changes:
- The map changed - many empty areas were removed in order to leave only important places on the map. That saved around 44% of the total map size, so loading times will be shorter. That change also influenced rendering time when playing the game so everyone should see additional frames. But also there is enought space for you villages, so don't worry! :). We want to create as dense and as interesting a world as we can. That's why we decided that we need to remove some empty places. It's also the first step for creating a traveling system. The next step is to add boats that players will be able to use to travel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31026261/9f658989e75b84449c89b7a18ba91bea069c5455.jpg[/img]
- Shadows were changed/optimized. On ultra settings you will get an extra 7ms on rendering shadows, which can lead to an additonal 20 fps (eg. GTX 1060 - we have got 20 fps more comparing to previous build). Low shadows settings can give you even 40 fps more comparing to previous game build. There is still work to be done about shadows in order to make them perfect, but we wanted to release a new system as soon as we could.

[h3]FIXED/CHANGED:[/h3]
- Vendor in the village won't eat food from the storehouse
- Fixed saving feathers, tallow and leather in the storehouse
- After killing a few animals in the barn player got resources only for one
- When killing animals in the barn, player didn't get leather
- Amount of light in dark places like caves, dungeons, houses. Now it's brighter so you will be able to see and fight enenies when exploring the world.
- Lowered prices for fast travel system
- Opened entrance to the pyramid in the jungle island (Puzzle was temporarly hidden and will be used in the future update)
- Torches bug - when torch got empty, new one was spawned and attached to the hand so player got two
- Lowered fall damage 4 times
- Changed color and brightness of items that player can't create in crafting window and in building window
- Position of in-game tutorial to make it more visible to players
- Friends that are visible (By using Q button) vanished when player opened any window and didn't appear when player closed it
- More money when starting the game (now random number between 650-750 coins)

notes.title: The Warhorn Patch - Ver. 0.8.2.7
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31026261/3a0f5751e95182b54dc688afa807e47bf8a61ef3.png[/img]

- ADDED:  '/unstuck' command 
- ADDED: Dedicated Servers can edit PvP setting in the config file.
- ADDED: Gamma and Saturation settings in the Gameplay Settings.
- ADDED: Setting for turning off camera shakes when hitting objects.
- ADDED: Sleeping in a bed. (If everyone on the server will go to bed, then time will change).
- ADDED: You can drink potion in the INV by clicking RMB and selecting drinking action.
- ADDED: You can see all the items that you will be able to craft in your NPC window in the future. (When higher level of the NPC is needed)
- ADDED: You can hide an item that you have in hand by pressing the same slot number its currently in.
- FIXED: Players could walk through windows of built walls in the villages.
- FIXED: When player left you could talk to him.
- FIXED: Problem with duplication items from the dead body by fast clicking with CTRL.
- FIXED: Problem with duplication items in the chest by using CTRL+SPACEBAR.
- FIXED: Problem with disappearing items from a chest when fast mouse clicking with CTRL.
- FIXED: When coming back the the game, player saw trees that were cut.
- FIXED: Problem when filling bottle with clean water from the barrel gave dirty water.
- FIXED: When RMB on the bow in the INV it had some icon to do some action.
- FIXED: You couldn't edit and upgrade your castle walls when reloading the game.
- FIXED: Eating food by RMB in INV sometimes gave 2 times more food.
- FIXED: You couldn't scroll list of quests in the window.
- FIXED: You couldn't destroy placed bear traps.
- FIXED: Blink rune was removed from the vendor in Stone City
- FIXED: After finishing Snaffs quest, Rojkos will give 1 LVL building plans, instead of LVL 2.
- FIXED: Items were falling through a floor in the shelter.
- FIXED: Simons quest. Spelling errors.
- FIXED: Smaller ammount of EXP for spider in the cave.
- FIXED: Maximum distance that giant spider can go from spawn location.
- FIXED: In order to learn building plans (plank, stone, brickstone), you have to know how to build previus types of buildings (need previus plans learned).
- FIXED: UVs of the ceiling in the blacksmiths building.
- FIXED: After dying, when map was opened it didn't disappear from the screen.
- FIXED: Disappearing chests in the townhall.
- FIXED: After typing password for the server and hitting accept button it didn't connect to the server.
- FIXED: After talking to a player and closing that window by ESC, you couldn't talk to a NPC


If you have any questions or suggestions about the game join the server!
https://discord.gg/eqzNPMj
